name: Postomatic
author: Fred

sections.description:
Postomatic helps you generate high-quality blog posts automatically using AI technology. Simply set your preferences
like categories, keywords and tags, then let Postomatic create engaging content. Get started right away with free
credits to try out the plugin.

External Service Notice

This plugin relies on an external service to function:

Service Name: Postomatic API by Buildomatics
Service URL: https://buildomatics.com/v1
Terms of Service: https://buildomatics.com/pages/postomatic/agreement
Privacy Policy: https://buildomatics.com/pages/postomatic/privacy

The plugin connects to Postomatic’s API when you generate content, purchase credits, activate plans, or request support. Only essential data (Such as your WordPress site URL, initialization token, admin email, and site name) is transmitted during these operations and only when initiated by you.

The plugin will not function without this connection. By using the plugin, you acknowledge and accept these external connections.

Legal Information

  • Plugin Modification Disclaimer: You are free to modify Postomatic under the terms of the GPL license. However, we cannot provide support or guarantee compatibility for modified versions of the plugin.
  • Hosting and Server Responsibility: Users are responsible for ensuring their hosting environment is secure, up-to-date, and compatible with Postomatic. We are not responsible for any site issues resulting from misconfiguration or outdated environments.
  • AI Content Disclaimer: The content generated by Postomatic is produced using AI models trained on publicly available data. We do not guarantee that the generated content is original or free from third-party copyright claims. Users are solely responsible for reviewing and editing all generated content before publishing.
  • External API Usage: This plugin connects to the external Postomatic API (https://buildomatics.com/v1) to perform tasks such as post generation, subscription management, and credit tracking. Only the necessary data is transmitted and only when you initiate actions that require it.
  • Privacy and Data Protection: We collect and process only the information necessary to operate the plugin and connect with your account. For details, please see our full Privacy Policy at: https://postomatic.com/privacy
sections.faq:
Does this plugin work without an external service?

No. Postomatic requires a connection to the Postomatic API to generate content, manage plans, and perform key functions. This API connection is required and is clearly explained above.

What are the payment options for Postomatic?

Postomatic offers a free tier with up to 4 blog posts. After that, you can either purchase credits to continue using the free plan or upgrade to one of our paid plans. All paid plans are one-time payments with no recurring fees and include lifetime access to features and updates while Postomatic remains under active development.

How does post generation work?

Postomatic uses AI technology (specifically ChatGPT) to generate blog posts based on your preferences. You can specify categories, keywords for the title, and tags you want the post to include. The generated content is SEO-optimized with appropriate meta descriptions.

Can I review posts before they go live?

Yes. You can choose to save generated posts as drafts, which allows you to review, edit, and add images before publishing. You can also schedule posts for future publishing dates.

What information is shared with the Postomatic API?

Only essential data like your WordPress site URL and initialization token is transmitted to the API, and only when you initiate actions like generating content, purchasing credits, or requesting support.

Is the generated content unique and free from copyright issues?

The content is generated using AI models trained on publicly available data. While the content is typically unique, we cannot guarantee it is free from third-party copyright claims. Users are responsible for reviewing and editing all generated content before publishing.

How do I get support for Postomatic?

Support is available through the WordPress admin panel or via your Postomatic account dashboard.
